failures.claim: The section refers to effects over the short, medium and long term but does not specify the time horizons for each identified risk/opportunity or define short/medium/long term.
The section does not disclose progress against previously disclosed plans or trade-offs considered in strategy and decision-making.

warnings.claim: The Strategy section provides information intended to enable users of general purpose financial reports to understand the current and anticipated effects of sustainability-related risks and opportunities on the entity’s business model and value chain.

The entity discloses information enabling users to understand the current and anticipated effects of sustainability-related risks and opportunities on the entity’s business model and value chain, including describing those effects and where they are concentrated (e.g., geographical areas, facilities, types of assets).

The entity discloses quantitative and qualitative information about how sustainability-related risks and opportunities affected financial position, financial performance and cash flows for the reporting period.
In preparing disclosures about anticipated financial effects, the entity uses all reasonable and supportable information available at the reporting date without undue cost or effort.
